title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
teachers:
KAMADA Hiroshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: The goal of this course is to help students determine their course of future employment or graduate school, and to prepare them for working on their own. The course covers two primary topics:1. Helping students learn the attitudes and approach from career selection to decision. 2. Motivating students to learn the contents and standards of the type of job or graduate school they have selected, ensure they have the necessary aptitude, scholastic ability, education, etc.
advice:
In this course, students will cover the following items:

1. Guidance on employment and graduate school
2. Employment practice examination (general education, general aptitude, and specialty)
3. Use of employment notes named “FUTURE”
4. Resume, motivation writing method, and self-appeal method
5. Career-related procedures, document entry methods
6. Attitudes towards individual/group interviews
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II, which are held in the first and second semesters, are lectures covering career activities in the next fiscal year. They are held to prepare students to take necessary measures, make preparations for severe employment conditions, and/or for going on to graduate school. All students are required to take these courses -regardless of their future advancement or employment prospects -as preparation for career planning, employment, and advancement.
